observations.text: Subjects (主体) are an account-level top-level library reachable from the global rail; the same list is exposed inside the canvas as the 主体库 modal and as the @ picker in prompts.
Two tabs: 个人添加 (user-created, empty on this account) and 公共主体 (platform presets, ~62). Bulk upload exists (批量上传主体).
A subject bundles identity across modalities (image + voice), so it is meant to be reused in both image/video generation (@ reference) and lip-sync/avatar flows.
